# Joe Graham Photography

> Fine art and commercial photographer based in the Birmingham, Alabama metropolitan area.

Joe Graham (legal name Joseph Lee Graham; also known as Joseph Graham, Joseph L. Graham, and Joseph L Graham) is a professional photographer specializing in fine art, commercial, portrait, landscape, nature, and event photography. He is based in central Alabama and serves the greater Birmingham metro including Tuscaloosa, Huntsville, Montgomery, Gadsden, Anniston, Decatur, Hoover, and Gardendale. Travel beyond a two-hour radius from Birmingham is available with paid travel and accommodation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://joegraham.studio/): Photo-first homepage with a grid of portfolio highlights.
- [About](https://joegraham.studio/about.html): Profile page with bio, a rotating Top 8 from the portfolio, and contact links.
- [Portfolio](https://joegraham.studio/portfolio.html): Full photography portfolio — nature, landscape, portraits, commercial, documentary.
- [Journal](https://joegraham.studio/journal.html): Trip journals with maps, photos, and the history behind each place: Yosemite, Kauaʻi, the Big Island, the North Coast of California, and Boston, with more trips on the way.
- [Contact](https://joegraham.studio/contact.html): Contact form, service inquiries, astrology compatibility checker, and David Bowie era quiz.

## Location

Based in the Birmingham, Alabama metropolitan area. Available throughout central Alabama. Travel beyond two hours available with accommodation.

## Details

- Camera system: Fujifilm
- Approach: Natural light preferred. Fine art sensibility applied to commercial work.
- Selective: Takes on a limited number of projects. Prioritizes interesting work and meaningful collaborations.
